# Performance baseline (Q-14)

Measured 2026-10-12 from a cloud sandbox (egress via proxy) with `NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1`, Node v22.22.0. Raw data: `eval/perf/after-q15-2026-10-12.json`. Raster endpoint: public titiler.xyz (default). Geo service configured: no.

Method: real tools via `executeTool`; global `fetch` wrapped from outside to log each request. **Cold** = in-process cache reset (`_resetCache`) then call; **warm** = immediate repeat in the same process (app's L1 cache populated). `titiler_npy` = the first concurrent batch of `/stac/feature.npy` reads (scene cloud scoring); `titiler_npy_after` = later `feature.npy` reads issued one after another (masked stats, then render data). Stage time is wall-clock union (parallel requests counted once); "no request in flight" is app compute or waiting between requests. Sandbox egress adds proxy latency to every request, so absolute numbers are pessimistic versus a server near the data; the stage proportions and request counts are what carry over. "Cold" is cold for the app only: titiler.xyz and the STAC APIs keep their own caches, so repeat runs of this script on the same AOIs and dates can be faster than a truly first visit (and the first-tile numbers especially).

## AOIs

| id | place | km² | why |
|---|---|---|---|
| kasur | Kasur, PK (74.05, 31.12, 74.08, 31.15) | 9.5 | Fixed baseline AOI (irrigated Punjab cropland, hazy/dusty). |
| lahore | Lahore edge, PK (74.2, 31.28, 74.23, 31.31) | 9.5 | Fixed baseline AOI (peri-urban edge, mixed built/crop). |
| beauce | Beauce, FR (1.8, 48.3, 1.83, 48.33) | 7.4 | Temperate European large-field arable; frequent cloud, different S2 tile/UTM zone (31U). |
| iowa | Story Co., Iowa, US (-93.7, 42, -93.67, 42.03) | 8.2 | US Midwest row-crop grid; Landsat/S2 overlap region, UTM zone 15. |
| kitale | Kitale, KE (34.98, 1, 35.01, 1.03) | 11.1 | East African highland maize; equatorial cloud, southern-hemisphere-adjacent tiling, high elevation. |

## Reference: geo service (measured separately)

`services/geo` exists in this repo. **Not measured by this script.** Another agent measured it separately: September NDVI composite over Kasur, **11.5 s cold / ~1.2 s warm**. Not directly comparable with the rows above (a composite over many scenes vs. a single-scene tool call; different environment and date), and the app does not call it unless `GEO_SERVICE_URL` is set.
